_comment: Auth gap baseline for docs/lesser/contracts/openapi.yaml. Each entry is an endpoint missing a `security:` block in the pinned Lesser OpenAPI snapshot. The fix belongs in Lesser's route contracts. Do not hand-edit openapi.yaml in Greater.
_instructions: When Lesser publishes a release with auth metadata fixes, resync this snapshot and regenerate this baseline via: node scripts/check-openapi-auth.mjs --write-baseline

known_gaps.note: Intentionally anonymous, not an upstream defect. Signup ceremony entry point: it issues the WebAuthn creation challenge before any credential or account exists, so there is nothing to authenticate. Lesser's public-surface rules classify the route anonymous and rate-limit it 20/5m (the pinned operation carries X-RateLimit-* headers and a 429 response, and declares no 401/403). The PROG-M1 M2 cross-client adversarial review verified that classification (verdict: agree — "Both routes public, 20/5m, classified anonymous"). Structurally identical to POST /api/v1/auth/webauthn/login/begin, which this probe already exempts by name. Do not report upstream as missing auth.

Intentionally anonymous, not an upstream defect. Signup ceremony completion: it verifies the attestation from /signup/begin and returns passkey_registration_proof, which the caller then spends on POST /api/v1/accounts — the proof, not a bearer token, is the credential here. Lesser's public-surface rules classify the route anonymous and rate-limit it 20/5m (the pinned operation carries X-RateLimit-* headers and a 429 response, and declares no 401/403). The PROG-M1 M2 cross-client adversarial review verified that classification (verdict: agree — "Both routes public, 20/5m, classified anonymous"). Structurally identical to POST /api/v1/auth/webauthn/login/finish, which this probe already exempts by name. Do not report upstream as missing auth.
